decisions.reason: Because this dismantling joint is very close to the firm’s core pipeline component business and there is no clear sign of underperformance, a boundedly rational management would likely keep it while learning from early market feedback.

As a related extension of the existing offer with its own product presentation and fit to the firm’s customization capabilities, it is likely to be retained unless early sales fall clearly below aspiration levels.

This pipe support bracket uses the firm’s established metal fabrication resources and broadens the range for infrastructure customers, so management would likely keep it absent strong evidence of a shortfall.
